2026_05_IND_PIT.headline: Taylor tests Pittsburgh’s depleted interior as Rodgers seeks steadier drives
2026_05_IND_PIT.paragraph1: Indianapolis arrives in Pittsburgh after Jonathan Taylor scored twice in its London victory, while the Steelers are adjusting after a narrow loss to Cleveland. Pittsburgh placed defensive tackle Derrick Harmon on injured reserve, increasing the importance of gap discipline against Taylor. Colts quarterback Daniel Jones must avoid the mistakes that hurt Indianapolis in last season’s meeting, especially when T.J. Watt and the Steelers force obvious passing downs. Aaron Rodgers and Pittsburgh also need more consistent possessions after an uneven start under Mike McCarthy. Early-down rushing success could decide which quarterback faces pressure.
2026_05_IND_PIT.model_rationale: Indianapolis can test Pittsburgh’s weakened defensive interior with Taylor, but must protect the ball. The Steelers need disciplined run defense and steadier offensive execution to answer.
